name: Fresh Lamb Loin Chops (Trimmed, Pan-Seared with Rosemary)
whyItWorks: Lamb loin is the mini T-bone of lamb, consisting of the eye of loin and tenderloin. Naturally fine-textured, low in tough gristle, and easily assimilated.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim outer fat strip. Sear in a skillet for 3 minutes per side with sea salt and a pinch of dried rosemary.
